entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Diana. How can I help you today?
Hi Diana, I'm calling about an order I placed last month. I need to return a VeloBand Pulse HR monitor.
I can certainly look into that for you. Can I get your name and order number, please?
Sure, the name is Sam Jones, and the order number is VF77819-P.

Thank you, Sam. I see the order here, delivered on December 15th. To get started, could you tell me what specifically is the issue with the band? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference issue?
It's not a technical fault, the band works fine. The thing is, I never even got to use it. Right after it arrived, I had a sudden medical emergency.
Oh, I'm very sorry to hear that. I hope everything is alright now.

I'm recovering, thank you. I was in the hospital for a few weeks and had to undergo an unexpected surgery. So, the box has just been sitting here. I know it's been over a month, and I'm probably outside the return window.
I understand the situation, Sam. Let me just pull up the policy details for your item. One moment.

Right. I was hoping, given the circumstances, we could work something out. I don't expect a full refund, but maybe a partial store credit or a discount code for later? I really do want to use your products once I'm fully recovered.
I appreciate you explaining, but actually, there's no need to negotiate. I've just checked our policy, and you're perfectly fine.
Oh, really? I was sure I had missed the deadline.

Not at all. Our policy allows for returns up to 90 days from the delivery date. Since it's only been 33 days, you are well within that timeframe for a full refund. Your situation with the hospital sounds stressful enough without having to worry about this.
Wow, that's fantastic news. I completely misread the policy then. Thank you so much!

It's my pleasure. I'm processing the return for you now. I've just sent a prepaid shipping label to the email address on file. Just pack the VeloBand in its original box, attach the label, and drop it off. You'll see the refund in 3-5 business days after we receive it. Is there anything else I can help with?
No, that's perfect. You've been a great help, Diana. Thank you.
You're very welcome, Sam. I wish you a speedy recovery. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
